http_calls.body: var c = Zotero.Collections.getByLibraryAndKey(1, 'COLLAAAA'); if (!c) { return {ok:false, error:'collection COLLAAAA not found'}; } var ids = c.getChildItems(true); var items = ids.map(id => Zotero.Items.get(id)).filter(i => i && i.isRegularItem && i.isRegularItem()); var missing = []; for (var item of items) {   var aids = item.getAttachments();   var hasPdf = false;   for (var aid of aids) {     var a = Zotero.Items.get(aid);     if (a && a.attachmentContentType === 'application/pdf') { hasPdf = true; break; }   }   if (!hasPdf) {     missing.push({key: item.key, title: item.getField('title'), DOI: item.getField('DOI') || ''});   } } return {ok:true, total: items.length, missing: missing, missing_count: missing.length};
